inlines.v: ABASH', verb transitive [Heb. and Ch. bosh, to be confounded, or ashamed.] To make the spirits to fall; to cast down the countenance; to make ashamed; to confuse or confound, as by exciting suddenly a consciousness of guilt, error, inferiority, _e. They heard and were abashed.
